mentions.name: Energy industry agent tooling
mentions.description: This is agent tooling for building models and proof-of-concept projects for energy industry applications. It draws on the author's consulting experience with data center builds, and the author hopes to spin it into a product soon.
mentions.source_excerpt: For work related items I’ve been building out agent tooling for building some models and PoC projects related to energy industry applications. Been doing the consulting thing for a bit now and gaining more broad knowledge on some of these data center builds. Hoping to spin this into a product soon.
